verdict.rationale: Jan's first-party docs and README show you can download open models from Hugging Face or import local GGUF files, then run them through a llama.cpp-powered engine and local API server that 'runs entirely on your computer.' Privacy claims back this up: 'Everything runs locally when you want it to' and 'Zero data collection until you say so.' Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that no data leaves the device during local inference.
